sections.Profile:
"Lucky Smile" is a gambling-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Inder in 1976. The game accommodates up to four players and features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and four kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Gambling, Original Theme, 1970s
